property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, calling transfer completes successfully (does not revert) on the correct contract; the mutant that loops with i <= _tos.length can index out-of-bounds and therefore can revert for some fuzzed inputs (when _tos.length>0).
change_summary: Change loop condition to i <= _tos.length so it will read out-of-bounds and revert when _tos.length>0 (by causing index == length access).
